instruction:
On PubMed, search for the phrase large language model in the Title field. Apply the Review article-type filter and the past-five-years publication-date filter, then sort by Most Recent. Report the first three results in displayed order with full title, PMID, publication type, and complete journal citation.

Stopping condition: Stop after the required query, both filters, and sorting are visibly applied and the first three results and requested fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use PubMed's Title field rather than an unrestricted all-fields search.
- Use the Review article-type filter, not Systematic Review unless PubMed also classifies a returned result as Review.
- Use the relative past-five-years filter shown by PubMed and do not replace it with an assumed calendar-year range.
- Preserve the displayed result order, PMID, publication type, and complete journal citation exactly.
